description: The layout, revision and render state of a stills post. render.state is queued, rendering, retrying, done or failed (with the stage and error); ready is true once the slides for this revision are drawn. The app listens for changes, so it does not poll; an agent calls this after stills_create or stills_change.

schema_version.description: The stills document version the app speaks (3 now; leave out for 1). An older app gets documents in its own version, or an UPDATE_REQUIRED refusal when the layout uses something only a newer version can hold.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_get
title: Read a stills post
